link.title: Build a drone in Blockly
link.description: The quadcopter the Rete and TypeScript tutorials build, made of blocks in the Blockly editor with a picture after every step: variables for its sizes, functions for every part, loops that repeat a part around the drone and cut its holes, async functions that await the geometry they measure, a canopy with a honeycomb and the bitbybit logo, sprung landing legs and a camera. The finished drone is the Blockly showcase.
